notes: v653 - two fixes. First, when Best Evidence Today comes back empty it now tells you the liquidity floor you have set and how many shares that leaves in scope. If the floor is $1m or higher it says so plainly, because a high floor removes most shares under a dollar - which is exactly where these patterns usually fire, so an empty result looks like a fault when it is really a filter you set earlier and forgot. The message used to say 'no tradeable share', which was misleading: the shares are tradeable, they were filtered out. Second, three garbled characters that showed as 'U0001f331' in messages now render as the intended symbols. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
